work.title: The problem, what I built, what changed.

maslinescu.title: Măslinescu® — an olive-oil shop with its own ops room
maslinescu.problem: A growing store where a silent PHP error or a blocked order email means lost sales — and nobody finds out until a customer calls.
maslinescu.built: Custom WP plugins — an AI shopping assistant, order statuses synced automatically with Fan Courier, a tiered loyalty club that also counts in-store purchases, photo & video reviews — plus a Grafana + Loki stack with Slack alerts.
maslinescu.result: Orders update themselves as parcels move, customers get product advice at any hour, and problems surface in Slack before anyone calls. Every plugin ships through PHPStan, tests and an automated deploy.

tablouri.title: TablouriColorate — a product configurator customers actually finish
tablouri.problem: After moving to WooCommerce, the canvas-print shop needed far richer product options. The jQuery version crawled during photo uploads, and the React rewrite that followed shipped 520 – 730 KB of JavaScript per page.
tablouri.built: One dependency-free configurator for six product types — canvas, multicanvas, collage, poster, banner and sticker — with crop previews drawn on canvas, prices computed on the server and hardened uploads.
tablouri.result: About 12 KB gzipped instead of 520–730 KB per page, one price formula shared by browser and server, and a new product, the multi-panel canvas: one photo printed across several canvases (up to 12), with the customer choosing what each panel shows. On a maintenance plan since 2018.

lumea.title: Lumea BookTruck — volunteers upload from the field, no accounts needed
lumea.problem: The BookTruck mobile library of Cărțile pe Față lends books to children in rural schools — and every trip leaves stock to track, returns to chase and photos scattered across volunteers' phones and WhatsApp groups.
lumea.built: A Next.js + Prisma + Better Auth panel for the catalogue, stock per location and loans — one ISBN scanned in the browser and one confirmation — plus one-link upload sessions that send files straight to the NGO's Google Drive in chunks that resume after an error.
lumea.result: One link per trip, files land organised in Drive, and large uploads never pass through — or overload — the server. Librarians and volunteers share one panel with role-based permissions.

design.title: Design
design.p1: The current design, from 2026, was generated by Claude and put into code with Claude Code: proof first — case studies with the problem, what I built and what changed — on paper and ink surfaces, hairline rules instead of shadows and a single blue, #3598DB. Every page has a light and a dark theme.
design.p2: Headings and body text are set in <schibsted>Schibsted Grotesk</schibsted>; labels, numbers and code in <plex>IBM Plex Mono</plex>. Both are served by next/font, without requests to Google at runtime.

metadata.description: Which cookies and browser storage vladilie.ro uses, why, for how long, and how to change your choice.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie policy
cookie-policy.lead: Short version: one cookie that remembers your choice, one setting for the theme, and anonymous statistics only if you agree. No advertising, no tracking across sites.

what.title: What cookies are
what.p1: Cookies are small text files a website saves in your browser. Similar technologies, such as localStorage, keep data in the browser in the same way. This page covers both, because the law treats them the same.

used.title: What this site uses
used.p1: Strictly necessary items are always on, because the site can’t respect your choices without them. Statistics run only after you accept them.

consent.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected statistics, so the banner doesn’t come back on every page.

theme.purpose: Remembers the theme: “system” (follow your device) until you switch to light or dark yourself.
theme.duration: Until you clear your browser data

analytics.type: No cookie or storage — a script that sends page views
analytics.purpose: Counts visits per page, with the referring site, country, browser and device type, so I know which pages are useful. Visitors are not identified or followed across sites.
analytics.duration: Nothing is kept in your browser

not-used.title: What this site doesn’t use
not-used.p1: No advertising or social media cookies, no Google Analytics, no embedded videos or third-party widgets. Fonts are served by the site itself and images go through it too, so loading a page doesn’t contact other companies. The contact form sends your message by e-mail and sets no cookies.

choice.title: Changing your choice
choice.p1: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time, just as easily as you gave it:
choice.p2: You can also delete cookies and site data from your browser settings; the banner will then ask again on your next visit.

contact.title: Questions
contact.p1: For anything about your data, see the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> or write to me through the contact page.
